title: Bike Renting Centre V2
titleZh: 自行车租赁中心（版本二）

questions.question: To subscribe to City Cycle you need to

analyses.content: 录音明确说到订阅服务可以在线上完成（do that online），也就是去市政委员会的网站（website）。
你可能会因为没听清“online”而犹豫，但紧接着录音强调了是去“website（网站）”，可以直接排除线下办理相关的A和B选项。
Now, to use City Cycle, 1st you need to subscribe to the service, and you can do that online. Just go to the City Council website and follow the prompts, and you'll be sent a card.

questions.question: At the station you choose your bike by

analyses.content: 录音直接说明你可以通过“触摸屏幕（touching the screen）”来选择你想要的自行车。
录音紧接着用“don't need a password（不需要密码）”明确排除了选项B，注意听否定词“don't”以排除干扰。
You'll be shown a diagram of the bikes that are currently available at the station, so you just choose the one you want by touching the screen. You don't need a password or anything.

options.option: 30 seconds to take it from the rack.
options.optionContent: 30 seconds to take it from the rack.

options.optionContent: about 10 seconds to take it from the rack.

questions.question: After choosing your bike you have

analyses.content: 录音提到按下释放按钮后，你有大约10秒钟（about 10 seconds）的时间把车从车架上取下。
如果你在录音前没仔细看选项，可能会跟不上步骤，但紧随“push the release button（按下按钮后）”的动作限制时间就是10秒，立刻锁定B。
Once you've chosen your bike, you can then go to where the bikes are stored and push the release button. After you do that, you have about 10 seconds to take the bike out of the rack.

options.optionContent: return it to the same station.

options.option: make sure it is properly secured in the rack.
options.optionContent: make sure it is properly secured in the rack.

questions.question: To return the bike you must

analyses.content: 录音强调还车时，确保自行车被妥善固定好（properly secured）非常重要，这与选项C完全对应。
你可能会听到“one of the stations”，这说明还车可以在任何一个站点，直接排除了必须回到“同一个站点（same station）”的选项B干扰。

Now, at the end of your trip, just come back to one of the City Cycle stations and wheel the bike into the bike rack. It's important to make sure that the bike is properly secured because you could be held liable if it goes missing.

options.option: has been properly locked in place.
options.optionContent: has been properly locked in place.

questions.question: A green light on the rack means the bike

analyses.content: 录音指出车架上的绿灯是用来确认自行车已经被锁好在正确位置（locked into place）。
如果你只抓住“green light”去联想“通行”或“可用”，就容易错选A，务必听完整句语义“confirm... locked into place”。
The green light on the rack will confirm that it has been locked into place.
录音明确指出咖啡车（coffee cart）位于前台（reception desk）和自动售货机（vending machines）之间，对应图上的位置E。
地图题容易找错参照物，一定要跟紧起点（entry），听到“between A and B”的典型方位词就能立刻锁定E点。
That's why you'll see a coffee cart. That's it there between the reception desk and the vending machines.
录音将视线拉回入口（entry），指出前台左侧（left of reception）、靠近Donovan Street那一侧的大房间就是维修间（workshop），对应位置F。
你可能在看图时跟丢了，但录音给了双重定位：前台左侧+Donovan Street那一侧，听到这两个参照物就不会错选成靠近入口的C。

Look back at the entry on the map. Just to the left of reception, on the Donovan Street side of the building, you'll see quite a large room. That's the workshop, where cyclists will be able to leave their bikes for repairs while they are at work.
录音极其直接地说明了储物柜（locker room）位于地图的左上角（top left-hand corner），完美对应位置A。
不要过度解读“valuables”等干扰信息，地图题听到绝对方位词“top left-hand corner”就应立即下笔。

If you have any valuables with you, you can leave these in our lockers. The locker room is in the top left-hand corner of your plan. So you can store your bag or wallet there before you head off for a shower.
录音说明淋浴间（showers）位于吹风机（hair dryers）的左侧，并且紧靠出口（near the exit），对应位置H。
你可能会把目光停留在上半部分房间，但“near the exit”是个强烈的方位指引，结合“left of the hair dryers”能迅速排除旁边无视方向的G。
We've installed 10 state-of-the-art power showers. They are located in this room here, to the left of the hair dryers and just near the exit.
录音指出你可以在饮水机（water cooler）旁边（next to）拿到毛巾（towel），因此饮水机旁边的位置就是B。
如果只听到“towel”而忽略了关键参照物“water cooler”，就容易在图上乱找，务必绑定参照物进行定位。
There's also a water cooler available, so you can grab a drink and then pick up a towel next to the water cooler there.
